title: Templates
description: The registration terms people accept, the contract instructors sign and the emails that go out, in three languages.
newDescription: Choose what it is for, give it a name, then write the text in all three languages.
copyDescription: Starts with the text of “{name}”. The original doesn’t change.

terms.title: Registration terms
terms.description: What people accept when they register: cancellations, refunds and the rest. Each workshop uses the default, unless you choose another one for it.
terms.hint: Accepted by participants when they register.
terms.emptyDescription: Registration needs terms to accept. Create the first one; it becomes the default.

contract.title: Instructor contract
contract.description: The fixed clauses of the contract an instructor signs for each workshop. New contracts use the default.
contract.hint: Signed by the instructor for each workshop.
contract.emptyDescription: Workshops can’t be created without one. Create the first one; it becomes the default.

usage.workshops: {count, plural, one {Chosen by # workshop} other {Chosen by # workshops}}
usage.contracts: {count, plural, one {# contract} other {# contracts}} ({signed, plural, =0 {none signed yet} other {# signed}})
usage.registrations: {count, plural, one {Accepted in # registration} other {Accepted in # registrations}}

default.terms: Used by every workshop that doesn’t choose its own terms

description.terms: Workshops without their own terms will use this text from now on. People who have already registered keep what they accepted.
description.contract: Contracts sent from now on will use this text. Contracts already sent or signed don’t change.

delete.title: Delete “{name}”?
delete.description: This can’t be undone. Its earlier versions stay in the activity log.
delete.dangerDescription: Only a template that is not the default and that nothing uses can be deleted.
delete.isDefault: This is the default, so it can’t be deleted. Make another template the default first.
delete.inUse: Workshops, contracts or registrations refer to this template, so it’s kept as a record and can’t be deleted.

notice.terms: People who have already registered keep a record of the terms they accepted, so your changes only apply to new registrations. Earlier versions stay in the activity log.
notice.contract: Signed contracts keep the exact text that was signed, so your changes never alter them. They apply to contracts signed from now on, including any still waiting for a signature. Earlier versions stay in the activity log.

fields.name: Name
fields.nameHint: Only admins see this name, for example “Summer terms” or “Contract for children’s workshops”.

form.aboutDescription: What the text is for, and a name to recognise it by.

textDescription.terms: Shown on the registration page, above the checkbox people tick to accept. Write it in all three languages.
textDescription.contract: The clauses of the contract. The top part (the two parties, the workshop details, the fee and the advance payment) is added automatically from the workshop, so write only the clauses here, in all three languages.

form.placeholdersHint: Click one to add it where the cursor is. It is filled in automatically when the text is shown.
form.formatHeading: at the start of a line: a section heading
form.formatItem: at the start of a line: a list item
form.formatParagraph: an empty line: a new paragraph
form.unknownItem: {token} ({language}): check the spelling, or remove it.

placeholders.fee_type: Fee type: per participant or fixed
placeholders.decision_deadline: Date and time of the go / no-go decision

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: How the text will look, with your brand name and example details. Highlighted parts are filled in automatically.
preview.hint: See the text as people will read it, with example details filled in.
preview.empty: Nothing to show yet. Write some text in this language first.

errors.notFound: This template no longer exists. It may have just been deleted.
errors.unknownPlaceholder: This text has a placeholder we don’t recognise. Please check the spelling inside the curly brackets.
errors.deleteDefault: The default template can’t be deleted. Make another template the default first.
errors.inUse: This template is in use, so it can’t be deleted.

emails.title: Emails
emails.description: Sent automatically, for example the contract to sign or a registration confirmation. Change any text in any language; what you leave empty keeps the default text.

fields.subject: Subject
fields.previewHint: The short line most inboxes show after the subject.
fields.heading: Heading

form.textsDescription: Leave a language empty to keep the default text, shown in grey. The greeting, the details and the signature are added automatically.
form.placeholdersHint: Filled in when the email is sent. Write them exactly like this, with the curly brackets.
form.previewDescription: With example details. Nothing is sent.
form.previewFailed: The preview can’t be shown yet.

reset.title: Use the default texts again?
reset.description: Your texts for this email are removed in all three languages. The activity log keeps a copy.

toast.reset: The default texts are used again.

errors.syntax: Check the curly brackets: each '{' needs a '}', and they are only for placeholders.
errors.placeholder: {name} isn’t a placeholder of this email. Use one from the list, or remove it.
errors.number: A text placeholder can’t be used as a number or a plural here.
